title: Clinical deployment and validation of a radiology artificial intelligence system for COVID-19
summary: A radiology AI system is deployed in a clinical infrastructure to process chest radiographs for COVID-19 inference and triage.
ai_technology: PXS Score convolutional Siamese neural network within a radiology deployment pipeline
organization: Not stated in the reviewed material
